notes.title: Update: Plateau
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/62010bd7811dc9b5574af776a803c51c590ce22a.png
New block: Plateau

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/919dbea5694c94b733fa416d6f2c37e97721ef42.png
Shrapnel: 
The rate of fire depends on the amount of resources. Spends resources when attacking. Attacks 5 enemies at once. For each shrapnel nearby, it attacks one more enemy. For each gold nearby, increases damage by 30%. For each nearby crystal, the attack range increases by 100%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/af045bb0c2eca57a67aab8fcd600cf2eedef68fe.png
Arcana:
Damage and rate of fire depends on the current mana. Every 3rd shot is AoE.

Added one REROLL per game

Every 10 waves, the research speed increases by 10% automatically.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/760a05b1839237a38358bd8f97860c3ab9df1b53.png
Library: 
The cost of the library has been reduced.

notes.title: New map: Elven Forest
notes.content:
New map: Elven Forest

New Block: Elven 

Replicator:
Wood cost increase: 500->400
Cooldown between transformation: 3s->1s

Ash block:
When the tower is on highground: xp 1.3x

Improved Crossbow:
Range: +10
Leveling up: xp x2

Spiral:
Wood cost increase: 150->100
Starting cost of the tree: 100->25

Shredder:
Wood cost increase: 150->100
Starting cost of the tree: 500->300

Golem:
Fixed a bug where the golem levels up very slowly. Now it levels up slower than a regular tower, but it works as originally intended.

notes.title: Ashlands Update
notes.content:
New block - Ash block

Highgrounds on this block provide 200% bonus damage, but disappear over time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/73e7c9b99c9e07e9ba4ae1163c3fd69bd5d42528.png

Ashen Mage
Fires 16 projectiles around himself, but disappears after 5 turns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/b126337f0cdd6a28b0a1676495c639971ba7053f.png

Empowered Crossbow 
Fires 3 arrows at once instead of one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/f571609b4d06d79f3b06345d80f631ac21e5e6c4.png

New Tower - Replicator
Copies a random nearby tower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/7c2d97bcd62cd947264d15f2d25997282acb5ef0.png

New Tower - Golem
Awakens after 5 waves and absorbs stones around itself, increasing damage for each stone absorbed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/6f58dda2be53ea62dd5551105317d2b0066c3b2f.png

New research - Hammer
Allows you to destroy tree, stone, gold deposit or crystal on the block.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113984/4e496e45a935dbb5df79e2a68edd43388ce19beb.png

Additional changes:

 New map
 New research card - replace block type
 Gamepad support
 German and Simplified Chinese localization
 Pause menu
 General UI improvement


Next map is coming in December, stay tuned for the updates!
